Definition: a prolonged form of G3427; to me:--I, me, mine, my.
BiblicalUsage: Emoi is simply 'to me' — the dative of 'I.' Jesus says the one who follows me shall not walk in darkness in John 8:12, and the King says that what was done to the least of His brethren was done unto me in Matthew 25:40.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this little word is where the gospel gets personal — Jesus does not speak about people in general, He speaks to me, and what I do to others I do to Him.
